The solutions are sold to various international customers to enable them to control their robotic work cells. Smooth integration and scalable deployment are key goals.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p style=&quot;color: !important;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;AgileCore is meant to be a scalable platform that supports multiple projects in parallel. That only works if the platform underneath scales with it - if it stays fast, thread-safe, and diagnosable as projects, devices, and operating conditions multiply.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p style=&quot;color: !important;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;We are looking for a&amp;nbsp;Senior C++ Performance Engineer to join our AgileCore Runtime core team. This is a T-shaped role in a small senior team: you are a full member of the core team first - contributing to the Runtime, reviewing contributions from the teams that build on our platform, and sharing our support and release duties - and within the team, you own the performance and stability practice as your specialization.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p style=&quot;color: !important;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;On the specialization side, you will drive the performance of the Runtime core - the Blackboard, the Behavior Engine and the execution paths beneath them - make the system provably thread-safe under load, and make failures in the field fast to diagnose. You own the practice: the methodology, the tooling, the benchmarks, the audits and the education. You work hand in hand with the platform architect, who owns the performance budgets and hot-path interface contracts at the architecture level - you turn those budgets into measured, enforced reality and shape them with your findings. You set the standard for performance, concurrency and troubleshooting, and raise the team&#39;s ability to meet it without slowing feature development down.&amp;nbsp;This is a shipping role, not a research role: success is measured in merged improvements, closed field escalations and green regression gates - not in microbenchmark leaderboards. We optimize to the budget the product needs, not to zero.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Why this role&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Greenfield performance infrastructure: the benchmark suites, budgets and CI regression gates are yours to build, not inherit&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;A measurable, physical problem: your profiling and your benchmarks run against real robots on our hardware-in-the-loop rigs - where third-party plugins meet 1 kHz vendor control loops&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;A small senior core team with real ownership: your work becomes the standard the whole platform builds on&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Your Responsibilities:&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Own the latency, throughput, and jitter of the Runtime core components - the Blackboard (our typed, subscribable in-process data plane) and the Behavior Engine (skill execution tree, trigger handling) - and carry improvements end to end: from flame graph to merged change to a regression gate that keeps it fixed&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Build the real-time basis for the platform: scheduling policies and priorities, CPU affinity, allocation, and page-fault discipline on hot paths, and lock-free structures where they pay for themselves&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Be a full member of the Runtime core team: develop core components, review contributions from feature teams building on the platform, and take part in the team&#39;s support and release rotations&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Make performance measurable and enforced - benchmark suites, per-subsystem budgets, and regression gates in CI instead of surprises at a customer site&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Be the hands-on authority on thread safety: ownership models, lock hierarchies, memory-order reasoning, and eliminating whole classes of races through sanitizers, stress and soak testing&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Ensure the product holds across the&amp;nbsp;complete operational domain it is used in - every supported device, load profile, and deployment topology, not only the configurations that appear in a demo&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Improve debuggability so that factory deployment and support scale: tracing, structured logging, runtime metrics, crash and core-dump handling, symbols for stripped release binaries&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Carry performance and stability into the&amp;nbsp;Plugin SDK and its C ABI, where third-party plugins meet vendor control loops running at 1 kHz&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Investigate complex issues across software, OS, network, and hardware boundaries - including the hardest escalations from the field&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Partner with the platform architect on performance-critical design: propose and implement improvements within the platform&#39;s performance budgets and hot-path interface contracts, and feed measurements back into how those budgets are set&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Mentor engineers in performance, concurrency, and troubleshooting through code reviews, deep-dive sessions, design discussions and technical guidance - without producing overhead&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Essential Skills:&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong hands-on C++ development&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Based in Munich or open to relocate - we support relocation and visa sponsorship&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Strong written and verbal communication skills in English&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Strong experience with modern C++, ideally C++17 or C++20, including templates and compile-time design&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Proven&amp;nbsp;performance engineering: profiling before optimizing, reading flame graphs and hardware counters, and reasoning about tail latency and jitter rather than averages&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;A track record of&amp;nbsp;shipped performance work: improvements you carried from measurement through merged code to sustained enforcement in CI - not benchmarks in isolation&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Strong experience with&amp;nbsp;multi-threaded and concurrent programming: memory models, atomics, lock-free patterns, and the judgment to know when a plain mutex is the right answer&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Exposure to&amp;nbsp;real-time or near-real-time systems on Linux is strongly preferred: scheduling policies, preemption, priority inversion, CPU affinity, and the usual sources of jitter - deep prior RT experience is a plus, not a gate; the performance fundamentals matter more&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Strong&amp;nbsp;debugging skills using GDB, sanitizers (ASan\/TSan\/UBSan), Valgrind, perf, strace, ltrace, tcpdump, and core dumps&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Solid understanding of&amp;nbsp;Linux internals: processes, threads, IPC, signals, scheduling, memory management, buffering, and dynamic linking&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Experience with CMake and compiler toolchains (GCC, Clang)&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Experience writing&amp;nbsp;automated tests, including unit tests, integration tests, and hardware-related test strategies, as well as benchmarks and stress\/soak tests&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;A&amp;nbsp;pragmatic, team-first senior mindset: you optimize the things that matter to the product and stop when the budget is met; you share reviews, support, and release duties in a small senior team; you make your specialty a capability of the whole team rather than a silo - and you would rather ship a 30% win this week than discuss a 3% win for a month&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p style=&quot;color: !important;&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Beneficial Skills:&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Database internals: storage and index structures, concurrency control, MVCC, transaction and cache design - our Blackboard is essentially an in-process typed store&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Contributions to high-performance or systems software: allocators, runtimes, engines, databases, network stacks, kernels&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;A low-latency background: trading systems, real-time audio or video, telecom, or embedded motion control&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Extensive template metaprogramming and compile-time computation&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Knowledge of real-time Linux, kernel scheduling, IRQ handling, kernel\/user-space boundaries, and latency measurement with cyclictest, ftrace or eBPF&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;C++ ABI and plugin \/ shared-library API design that stays stable across compilers and toolchain versions&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Hands-on experience with instrumentation profilers such as Tracy (we use it), as well as perf, VTune, or similar&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;Windows internals and the MSVC toolchain - So, if you\u2019re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Support Group&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As the name Support Group implies, this group is responsible for the core part of the customer experience journey that has got Wolt top-notch ratings in app stores.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;During the years we\u2019ve invested a lot in the in-house built support tooling as we believe that it\u2019s the only way we can ensure the satisfaction of all of our customers and partners in each of the 25 countries that we operate in. We take huge pride in our customer operations\u2019 quality, so on top of building delightful support experiences in our consumer app we also want to proactively identify and solve issues even before our customers and partners even notice something might be wrong.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Support Analytics Team&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our Support Analytics team\u2019s main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants &amp;amp; Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. \ud83d\udca1&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What you\u2019ll be doing&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;Workforce Management (WFM) &lt;\/strong&gt;team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;Our humble expectations&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Required:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;5+ years of experience&lt;\/strong&gt; in a data science or analytics position&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience building&lt;strong&gt; forecasting models and time series analysis&lt;\/strong&gt; (Prophet, SARIMA, Holt-Winters or similar)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in&lt;strong&gt; Cost Analysis and What-if Scenario Analysis&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep knowledge of statistical packages in &lt;strong&gt;Python or R&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proficiency in writing structured and efficient&lt;strong&gt; SQL queries&lt;\/strong&gt; for large data sets&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to&lt;strong&gt; influence and advise senior stakeholders &lt;\/strong&gt;Good to have:&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience using ML for forecasting&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working with ML engineers\/ML platform&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Building data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What we offer&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote in &lt;strong&gt;Berlin. &lt;\/strong&gt;\ud83d\udc99&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don\u2019t learn, we won\u2019t stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda\u2019s greatest achievement.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;Next steps&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via &lt;a ----------\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;iframe src=&quot;https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/embed\/Ncz4s_oBczc?si=FzuwoSOLcv5WZVRN&quot; width=&quot;560&quot; height=&quot;314&quot;&gt;&lt;\/iframe&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span data-sheets-root=&quot;1&quot;&gt;Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-sheets-root=&quot;1&quot;&gt;We\u2019re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You may not meet every requirement, and that\u2019s okay. If this role excites you, we\u2019d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from the UK, Sweden, Spain or Germany.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the role:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer - SRE to help us support our highest value Grafana Cloud customers by increasing the reliability of our Cloud databases that are based on Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope. We provide these databases as a SaaS product from AWS, GCP, and Azure across all regions.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The SRE team is embedded within the Mimir, Loki, and Tempo squads and focuses on ensuring that Grafana Cloud\u2019s database products deliver exceptional reliability for our highest-SLA customers. In this role, you will:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner closely with product engineering squads (embedded model)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own production reliability for high-SLA and complex customer environments&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design and implement automation to scale our reliability practices&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensuring our customers meet our SLO targets&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define and evolve per-tenant SLOs and reliability models&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proactively reduce SLO burn to prevent repeat incidents&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serving as a primary escalation point and on-call for relevant incidents&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead customer-impacting incident response and post-incident reviews&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to design docs and code reviews&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Influence feature design to ensure production scalability and operability&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build automation to eliminate toil where needed&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Improve alert quality and reduce noisy escalations&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We seek a staff software engineer operating at the intersection of customer needs, production systems, and product engineering.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups\u2014always paired with strong code review and quality standards. You&#39;ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What we seek:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;8+ years engineering experience, 4+ in SRE\/CRE\/production engineering. Strong preference for those with formal customer reliability engineering experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong Kubernetes experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong experience with technical leadership, leading a team through projects, mentoring other engineers on the team and serving as a force-multiplier&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience operating multi-tenant systems in production&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong experience designing and implementing SLOs&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with one or more programming languages (e.g. Go, Python, Java, etc)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with Linux operating systems internals, and some knowledge of networking, cloud storage, and scaling.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with calmly and actively participating in blame-free Incident Response, following up on actions, and writing high quality PIRs (Post Incident Reviews, a.k.a. post-mortem documents)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to reason about performance, scaling, and failure modes&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfortable working within an engineering team where individuals are encouraged to have a strong sense of autonomy and self-direction.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to partner deeply with product engineering teams&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind (this is important!)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Your day-to-day will include:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Regular 1:1s to with your manager and colleagues&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Reviewing and creating SLOs, proactively investigating ways in which we can further reduce budget burn for those SLOs, which can be self-directed or as the result of learnings from incidents, and may include improvements to monitoring, automation, increasing self-healing, auto-scaling, etc.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Improve observability of customers within their environments&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Designing and implementing solutions to ensure reliability and scalability of our environments can meet rapidly increasing demands&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop fault-tolerant design patterns ensuring that we are considering reliability at all stages of the service lifecycle.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborating with our Engineering Leaders to help define and influence product strategy, roadmaps and technical designs&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participate in PR review and collaborating with other engineers on their Design Docs&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Teach others about Site Reliability Engineering and communicate best practices to be applied early in development of new features and functionality&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participate in Incident Response when applicable, including investigation through to resolution, PIR, and communication with customers via Bridge calls where necessary&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is \u20ac109,709 - \u20ac131,651.&amp;nbsp; Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. You will lead efforts to design, position, and close outcome-oriented professional services engagements that translate complex DevSecOps and digital transformation initiatives into clear, measurable mission-critical outcomes.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Reporting to the Senior Manager of Engagement Management, EMEA, you will work at the intersection of technical solutioning and customer requirements, aligning each engagement to their unique needs and objectives.&amp;nbsp; In your first year, you will build trusted advisor relationships with technical leaders and partners to help integrate professional services into account strategies from early discovery through successful delivery. This is a unique opportunity to shape large-scale implementations that improve how customers plan, build, secure, and operate software using GitLab.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Some examples of our projects&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Designing and structuring outcome-based professional services engagements that align GitLab capabilities to customers needs&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partnering with account executives, solutions architects, and delivery leaders to turn complex DevSecOps transformations into clear, actionable implementation roadmaps and statements of work&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build trusted advisor relationships with division chiefs, program managers, and technical leaders&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Conduct discovery sessions with with prospects and Systems Integrators to understand current-state capabilities, requirements and desired business outcomes&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design outcome-oriented services proposals that align GitLab capabilities with customer success metrics and objectives&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Structure engagements and commercial proposals to clear outcomes maintaining flexibility for staff augmentation and packaged offerings when needed&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop custom-scoped SOWs and staffing plans for complex implementations, engaging with technical architects and delivery leadership to ensure deliverability&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Articulate GitLab&#39;s services value proposition, catalog offerings, and implementation methodologies in the context of customer requirements&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Gain agreement on scope and price while guiding customers through commercial terms, procurement processes, and contracting structures&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage project- and account-level escalations, ensuring rapid resolution and maintaining customer confidence&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Position consulting, training, success tiers, and additional solutions proactively to ensure successful outcomes and long-term customer retention&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Facilitate solutioning sessions including implementation roadmapping, enterprise strategy discussions, and executive-level requirements gathering&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive measurable outcomes by structuring services that support customer success metrics, accurately forecasting services bookings, and tracking key performance indicators related to bookings, margin, and attachment to strategic opportunities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the engagement lifecycle from initial discovery and pre-sales solutioning through scoping, SOW development, staffing alignment, and transition to delivery, ensuring engagements are deliverable, clearly defined, and outcome-oriented.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Influence cross-functional teams by articulating GitLab\u2019s professional services value proposition in the context of federal requirements and compliance frameworks, and by feeding customer insights back into sales, delivery, and practice management.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with regional sales and engagement leadership to prioritize and manage services opportunities that support critical deals and strategic initiatives, providing clear recommendations on risk management, negotiation strategies, and commercial structures.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Foster a culture of enablement and continuous improvement by training field teams on how to position and sell professional services by sharing trends, feedback, and suggestions that improve go-to-market content and operational processes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated progressive experience structuring, scoping, and selling professional services engagements in the region&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven success operating in a pre-sales context, conducting discovery, designing outcome-oriented proposals, and developing custom statements of work (SOWs) and staffing plans for large, complex implementation projects.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps practices, and cloud transformation initiatives, with the ability to connect technical solutions to mission objectives and measurable business outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Effective communication and interpersonal skills with executive presence, able to build trusted advisor relationships with division chiefs, program managers, contracting stakeholders, and senior technical leaders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Highly developed facilitation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to guide customers through acquisition processes, commercial structures, and risk mitigation strategies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfort working cross-functionally with sales, solutions architecture, delivery, and operations teams to align on deal strategy, staffing, and successful execution in a fast-paced environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Capacity to work autonomously and asynchronously in a fully remote setting, managing multiple complex opportunities while maintaining accurate forecasting and consistent alignment with GitLab values and goals.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Professional Services Engagement Management team at GitLab is dedicated to designing and structuring services engagements that set our customers up for successful, long-term adoption of our DevSecOps platform. We build and manage strategic relationships with customers to understand their goals, surface their services needs, and translate complex transformation initiatives into clear, outcome-oriented engagement plans. Composed of experienced services, consulting, and delivery professionals distributed across multiple regions, we operate asynchronously to support field teams, shape implementation strategies, and guide customers through their services journey. We focus on creating scalable engagement models, fostering open communication with internal stakeholders, and adapting our services offerings to the evolving needs of a rapidly maturing organization and its customers. The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams globally.<\/span><\/p>\n<p><span style=\"font-size: 12pt;\"> You will help set the technical and architectural direction that the wider team \u2014 including our AI &amp; Automation Engineers and HR Tech Business Analysts \u2014 builds within. <\/span><\/p>\n<p><span style=\"font-size: 12pt;\">This role is based in Berlin, given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required. &nbsp;<\/span><\/p>\n<p><strong><span style=\"font-size: 24pt;\">About the Role<\/span><\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"line-height: 1.4; font-size: 12pt;\"><span style=\"font-size: 12pt;\">Work closely with FlixTech, shape Flix's target HR technology architecture across core HRIS, payroll, time &amp; attendance, talent, recruiting, document management and surrounding enterprise systems \u2014 ensuring the architecture enables our HR target operating and service-delivery model by connecting processes, roles, systems and service tiers while balancing global standards with local requirements.<\/span><\/li>\n<li style=\"font-size: 12pt; line-height: 1.4;\"><span style=\"font-size: 12pt;\">Drive global HRIS transformation initiatives, from major platform revamps and redesigns to potential HRIS migrations \u2014 evaluating technology options, building business cases, structuring programs through project plans and RAID\/risk frameworks, and driving execution through solution design, integrations, testing, cutover, parallel runs and stabilization.<\/span><\/li>\n<li style=\"font-size: 12pt; line-height: 1.4;\"><span style=\"font-size: 12pt;\">Define HR technology integrations and data flows between the HRIS and surrounding enterprise systems \u2014 determining what data moves between systems and through which integration patterns, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware and event-driven architectures.<\/span><\/li>\n<li style=\"font-size: 12pt; Today, nearly &lt;strong&gt;3,000 people&lt;\/strong&gt; work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;More than &lt;strong&gt;500,000 healthcare professionals&lt;\/strong&gt; use Doctolib\u2019s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately &lt;strong&gt;90 million people&lt;\/strong&gt; across Europe.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an &lt;strong&gt;AI-powered Health Companion&lt;\/strong&gt; that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you will build and lead&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As &lt;strong&gt;Product Design Director, Patient&lt;\/strong&gt;, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib\u2019s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;access to care, search and booking;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;patient messaging and teleconsultation;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;the Patient Health Record and patient context;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;the app homepage and daily health experience;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;health content and prevention;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;recommendations, reminders and care plans;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;new patient services and subscription experiences;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;conversational and AI-powered experiences.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The current team includes &lt;strong&gt;six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer&lt;\/strong&gt;. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Your mandate&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What success looks like&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In your first year, you will have:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What we are looking for&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You are likely to bring:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Why Doctolib, why now?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people\u2019s everyday health journeys.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will join at a defining moment:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of &lt;strong&gt;consumer product design, healthcare and AI&lt;\/strong&gt;, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric\u2014with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle\u2014Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what\u2019s next.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;em&gt;CORE VALUES&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;One Team. One Redwood&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Make Your Own Weather&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Obsess over Customer Success&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Work the Problem&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Be Curious&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Own the Outcome&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Respect Each Other&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;em&gt;YOUR IMPACT&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Gartner predicts that by 2029, 90% of organizations currently delivering workload automation will have transitioned to Service Orchestration and Automation Platforms (SOAPs) \u2014 a market expected to reach $4.9 billion by 2028. Redwood is the top-ranked vendor in Gartner&#39;s 2025 Critical Capabilities for SOAP, scoring #1 across all five use cases. We&#39;re expanding our Solutions Engineering team to meet that demand. In this role, you&#39;ll be the technical face of a category leader \u2014 helping enterprise prospects understand not just what Redwood does, but why it&#39;s the right answer in a market that&#39;s fundamentally changing.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Cover the full SOAP surface area.&lt;\/strong&gt; Present and position Redwood&#39;s capabilities across all five Gartner-defined SOAP use cases \u2014 IT workload automation, IT workflow orchestration, data orchestration, citizen\/self-service automation, and DevOps automation. You won&#39;t be a deep expert in all five on day one, but you&#39;ll develop enough fluency to lead discovery and qualify the right fit for each prospect.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Demonstrate Redwood&#39;s platform with AI fluency.&lt;\/strong&gt; Deliver compelling technical presentations and live product overviews that connect Redwood&#39;s AI capabilities \u2014 AI-powered observability, intelligent job scheduling, and agentic orchestration \u2014 to concrete operational outcomes, not just platform features.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Use AI tools as a force multiplier.&lt;\/strong&gt; Leverage LLM-based research, prompt-driven workflows, and AI productivity tooling as a standard part of how you work \u2014 accelerating demo preparation, account research, competitive analysis, and technical documentation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Position confidently in a competitive market.&lt;\/strong&gt; Develop a working understanding of the SOAP competitive landscape well enough to articulate Redwood&#39;s differentiation, handle objections live, and understand why you win and why you lose.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Drive technical evaluations hands-on.&lt;\/strong&gt; Lead proof-of-concept work with prospects to validate use cases and prove out business outcomes \u2014 including light scripting (REST APIs, Python, bash) where needed to close technical gaps.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Enable Account Executives.&lt;\/strong&gt; Provide technical insight, SOAP market context, and prospect feedback that sharpens messaging and accelerates new account acquisition.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stay ahead of the SOAP and AI landscape.&lt;\/strong&gt; Continuously deepen your understanding of how the market is evolving \u2014 from agentic AI and GenAI-powered automation to data pipeline orchestration and self-service automation \u2014 and bring that context into every prospect conversation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Uphold Redwood&#39;s standards.&lt;\/strong&gt; Maintain the highest ethical standards across all customer-facing work, representing the company with professionalism and technical credibility at every level of the prospect organization.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What we&#39;re looking for in how you work:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Resourceful:&lt;\/strong&gt; You&#39;re constantly curious, proactively learning new AI tools and technical capabilities as part of how you operate \u2014 not as a side project.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Competitive:&lt;\/strong&gt; You bring initiative, confidence, and a results-oriented mindset to every pursuit.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Goal-Oriented:&lt;\/strong&gt; You set meaningful objectives, track them rigorously, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Detail-Oriented:&lt;\/strong&gt; You&#39;re organized and exercise sound judgment \u2014 able to manage multiple technical evaluations and sales cycles simultaneously without things falling through.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Communicator:&lt;\/strong&gt; You can explain SOAP, AI, and automation concepts clearly to both a VP of Engineering and a CFO, and you know the difference matters.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Adaptable:&lt;\/strong&gt; You&#39;re comfortable shifting priorities and handling complex, dynamic requirements in a fast-moving enterprise sales environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;YOUR EXPERIENCE&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The most important thing we&#39;re hiring for is technical aptitude and intellectual curiosity. Domain knowledge can be taught \u2014 the ability to learn fast, think technically, and communicate clearly cannot.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What we require:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or adjacent technical role&lt;\/strong&gt; in enterprise software \u2014 Process Automation, ERP, Data Integration, Business Intelligence, ESB, or similar.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Technical aptitude.&lt;\/strong&gt; Working knowledge of REST APIs and comfort with light scripting (Python, bash, or equivalent) sufficient to build simple integrations, validate technical scenarios, or debug issues in a demo environment. You don&#39;t need to be a software engineer \u2014 but you need to be comfortable in that world.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools in a professional context&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 LLMs, prompt-based workflows, AI-assisted research, AI productivity tooling. This is a baseline requirement, not a differentiator. Bonus if you understand how AI capabilities like observability, intelligent automation, and agentic orchestration are being embedded into enterprise automation platforms specifically.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Familiarity with agentic AI and AI orchestration concepts.&lt;\/strong&gt; You understand what multi-agent systems are, how LLMs are being embedded into enterprise workflows, and can hold a substantive conversation with technical buyers about where this is headed.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;High-level ERP literacy&lt;\/strong&gt; across core business processes: Financials, Procure to Pay, Plan to Build, Quote to Cash, Reporting, and Data Quality.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Ability to bridge technical depth and business value&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 credible in a room with enterprise architects, while equally effective communicating ROI to executive stakeholders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Bachelor&#39;s degree&lt;\/strong&gt; from an accredited college or university.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;A head start \u2014 not a hard filter. We&#39;ll invest in the rest:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Prior exposure to workload automation, job scheduling, or enterprise orchestration platforms.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Familiarity with SAP environments \u2014 S\/4HANA, RISE with SAP, SAP BTP, or core SAP business processes. We operate deeply in this ecosystem and will develop this knowledge in you.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Awareness of data orchestration concepts \u2014 ETL\/ELT pipelines, DataOps workflows, data movement across hybrid environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Familiarity with DevOps toolchains and how automation intersects with CI\/CD, infrastructure provisioning, or SRE practices.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in Customer Success, Technical Support, or Professional Services.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;css-1i27f3a&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;css-ey7qxc&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;css-1s1axh3&quot; data-automation-id=&quot;jobPostingDescription&quot;&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you&#39;ll enjoy your career with us!&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;THE LEGAL BIT&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Redwood is an equal opportunity employer. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence \u2013 all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Clients value Baringa\u2019s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly \u2013 all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Certified as a&amp;nbsp;&lt;em&gt;Great Place to Work &lt;\/em&gt;around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the &lt;em&gt;Financial Times &lt;\/em&gt;in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by &lt;em&gt;Forbes &lt;\/em&gt;for four consecutive years as one of the World\u2019s Best Management Consulting Firms.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Our Commodities &amp;amp; Energy Trading practice is growing, and we are looking for (Senior) Managers (m\/w\/d) to join our team in D\u00fcsseldorf or Munich.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;As a (Senior) Manager, you will lead or deliver complex management consulting engagements for clients across commodity and energy trading, build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and help grow our practice. You will combine deep industry expertise with consulting and leadership skills, taking accountability for client outcomes, team performance and commercial development.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We work with leading commodity and energy trading organisations, utilities and large energy consumers. Our work spans strategy, operating model and process design, trading transformation, commercial optimisation, risk and regulation, flexibility integration, and technology delivery.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is an opportunity to advise influential organisations on strategic priorities and deliver meaningful change across trading operations, commercial performance and new technologies, while playing a visible role in building our German and European business.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;What you will be doing&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will take responsibility for delivering complex client engagements, leading project teams, building trusted client relationships and contributing to the growth of our Commodity &amp;amp; Energy Trading practice. The breadth of your responsibilities will reflect your experience and the level at which you join. Areas of work include:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Client leadership and delivery:&lt;\/strong&gt; Build trusted relationships with executive and senior client stakeholders, translate strategic priorities into practical programmes whilst owning complex engagements or major programmes from shaping through delivery, ensuring high-quality outcomes, strong governance and effective management of scope, risk and commercials.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Leadership &amp;amp; Business Development&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;:&lt;\/strong&gt; Identify and shape opportunities, lead proposals and pitches, develop propositions and account plans, and contribute to business development, revenue growth and capability building. Strengthen our market profile through thought leadership, external networks, sector insight and collaboration across Baringa capabilities and geographies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;Depending on your expertise, your client work may include:&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Operating model &amp;amp; business transformation: &lt;\/strong&gt;Leading trading operating model and business transformation engagements, helping clients optimise governance, processes and organisational structures to deliver sustainable operational change.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Digital &amp;amp; trading transformation: &lt;\/strong&gt;Delivering data, analytics and AI-enabled transformation initiatives, helping clients improve trading decision-making, operational efficiency and commercial performance.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Trading systems transformation:&lt;\/strong&gt; Leading ETRM\/CTRM transformation engagements, supporting strategy, implementation and optimisation initiatives while aligning business and technology stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Flexibility services &amp;amp; integration: &lt;\/strong&gt;Leading the delivery of flexibility strategy and integration engagements, helping clients unlock value from battery storage, renewable assets and enabling technologies across evolving energy markets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Risk and regulatory advisory: &lt;\/strong&gt;Advising clients on risk and regulatory challenges, enhancing risk management frameworks, governance and controls while supporting adaptation to evolving market and regulatory requirements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Your skills and experience&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for experienced professionals who combine management consulting experience with strong knowledge of commodity and energy markets, ideally within energy and commodity trading or trading transformation. You do not need experience across every commodity or capability listed below. We are looking for deep expertise in at least one relevant area, together with the ability to solve complex client challenges:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Significant experience delivering or leading complex consulting projects, transformation programmes or strategic initiatives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep expertise in at least one of Power, LNG, Gas &amp;amp; Clean Fuels, Metals or Oil, together with a strong understanding of trading organisations, markets and value chains.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Relevant expertise in one or more of the following areas: trading operating models, business process improvement, ETRM\/CTRM, data, analytics and AI, flexibility and optimisation, trading strategy and portfolio management, or risk and regulation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A track record of building trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders and influencing complex decisions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated experience in business development, including shaping opportunities, leading proposals or pitches, and converting client needs into valuable work.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience leading, coaching and developing project teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong problem-solving, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on delivery.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Professional proficiency in German and English.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559738&amp;quot;:200,&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(208, 0, 111); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Join us&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. We unite&nbsp;cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel&nbsp;in a single company \u2013&nbsp;powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open,&nbsp;to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit&nbsp;<a href=\"https:\/\/urldefense.com\/v3\/__http:\/\/wpp.com\/__;!!JboVxjCXSME!N9KGoZIn5nCC-uOWhEdE-ChrrJuf6TgkLzNNkLaW9BExJsVqZZ_hMSmGbARJ0tdBOnKYM7kEbv5L3ncUpg7-6uEPNdY$\" data-outlook-id=\"6ded86b6-cde3-4e48-958d-34727f881edd\">WPP.com<\/a>.<\/p><\/div><p><strong>A Hybrid working model<\/strong><\/p>\n<div>\n<div>\n<div>\n<div>\n<div>\n<p class=\"xmsonormal\"><em>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.<\/em><\/p>\n<\/div>\n<\/div>\n<\/div>\n<\/div>\n<\/div>\n<p><strong>What does a Global Hub Operations Director do at WPP Production?<\/strong>&nbsp;<\/p>\n<p>Lead the operational performance and development of Studio A's global production hub network. The role sets a consistent operating standard across locations, turns demand into credible capacity plans, and ensures hubs can deliver secure, high quality work at the service levels and economics agreed with the client. It connects Hub Operations Leads, delivery and capability leaders, Geo teams, Commercial, Talent, HR, Finance, Technology and Facilities so that decisions on capacity, location, cost and risk are made with one view of the facts.<\/p>\n<p>The Director leads through the Hub Operations Leads and the global operating cadence. They own the hub operating model and its execution, while partnering with the relevant functional and commercial owners on decisions outside hub operations.<\/p>\n<p><strong>Reporting&nbsp;lines and&nbsp;key stakeholders:<\/strong>&nbsp;<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>Reports to the Global Operations Director. Manages and develops the Hub Operations Leads across the global network, with clear local accountabilities and escalation routes.<\/li>\n<li>Covers centralised production hubs and the resources, infrastructure, controls and services required to support Worldwide and Geo demand, including permanent and flexible capacity.<\/li>\n<li>Works in a matrix with Heads of Delivery, capability SMEs, Geo and client operations, Commercial, Talent, HR, Finance, Security, Technology and Facilities. Local employment, technical craft and client commercial approval remain with their designated owners.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h4>Key Responsibilities:<\/h4>\n<h4>Global hub strategy and governance<\/h4>\n<ul>\n<li>Set the hub operating model, decision rights and governance for shared capacity, including how Worldwide and Geo demand is prioritised, allocated and escalated when requirements conflict.<\/li>\n<li>Maintain a practical Hub Playbook covering planning, onboarding, access and security, local compliance, service management, financial controls, business continuity and location specific requirements. Audit adoption and close gaps.<\/li>\n<li>Assess the hub footprint against demand, capability, resilience, cost, security and talent availability. Develop business cases and transition plans for expansion, consolidation or changes in the mix of work across locations.<\/li>\n<li>Run a regular hub leadership cadence, with consistent status reporting, decisions, actions and cross hub learning. Chair operational reviews and escalate material trade offs promptly.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h4>Capacity, workforce and delivery<\/h4>\n<ul>\n<li>Translate demand forecasts, Workshop peaks and capability plans into a rolling view of capacity by hub, skill, language, security classification and employment type. Test scenarios for changes in volume, complexity, timing and location.<\/li>\n<li>Work with Delivery, SMEs and Geo leaders to allocate shared resources, manage utilisation and productivity, protect service levels and balance work across hubs. Identify bottlenecks early and agree actions rather than relying on local workarounds.<\/li>\n<li>Set requirements for permanent and flexible staffing with Talent and HR; oversee readiness, onboarding, training and exit planning for large scale programmes and demand changes. Ensure employment classification and local legal or tax questions go to the accountable specialists.<\/li>\n<li>Lead operational readiness for Workshops and other surges, including space, technology, security, access, staffing, shifts, supplier support and contingency capacity.<\/li>\n<li>Own the operational response to a hub disruption. Keep tested continuity and recovery plans, including transfer options, cross training, access dependencies and client approvals where required.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h4>Commercial performance and controls<\/h4>\n<ul>\n<li>Provide the operational data and discipline needed to run the commercial model as agreed: retained capacity, complexity based deliverables and approved time and materials exceptions. Ensure work is coded and measured consistently so actual demand, effort and cost can be compared with the model.<\/li>\n<li>Partner with Commercial and Finance on forecast accuracy, capacity pool economics, the minimum spend commitment, margin, scope changes, rush requests and Workshop demand. Identify the operational causes of variance and propose corrective actions; do not change prices or commitments without the agreed approval route.<\/li>\n<li>Supply a reliable monthly operational pack covering volumes and complexity, capacity and utilisation, forecast accuracy, service levels, quality, revisions and exceptions. Support quarterly commercial reviews of spend, margin, demand, savings and capacity risks, and the annual review of unit prices, cost adjustment, efficiency commitment and baseline capacity.<\/li>\n<li>Drive measurable productivity and the contracted efficiency commitment through improved planning, workflow, automation and location mix while protecting quality, security and sustainable capacity. Validate savings with Finance and avoid double counting.<\/li>\n<li>Ensure hub financial procedures, hiring controls, approved rates, procurement and contractor processes are followed. Surface non compliant practices and remediate them with the accountable teams.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h4>Systems, data and improvement<\/h4>\n<ul>\n<li>Define the operational requirements and adoption plan for the resource management platform, including estimates, staffing plans, scenario planning, schedules, timesheets, PTO and overtime, capacity reporting and relevant integrations.<\/li>\n<li>Set data definitions, ownership and quality controls across hubs so leadership can trust capacity, productivity, delivery and cost reporting. Use the data to diagnose recurring constraints and measure whether interventions work.<\/li>\n<li>Partner with Technology and process owners on rollout of production tools, language capacity planning, freelancer management and workflow improvements. Ensure local teams are trained and changes are embedded.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h4>People, partnerships and risk<\/h4>\n<ul>\n<li>Lead, coach and assess Hub Operations Leads. Build an integrated leadership team with clear expectations, succession cover and consistent management standards across locations.<\/li>\n<li>Build trusted relationships with senior Delivery, Geo, capability and client operations stakeholders. Make trade offs visible, resolve competing priorities and communicate decisions with clarity.<\/li>\n<li>Oversee hub risks relating to security, confidentiality, health and safety, infrastructure, service continuity and local compliance. Maintain a visible risk and action log, with owners and deadlines, and escalate issues that need executive decisions.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h4>Measures of success<\/h4>\n<ul>\n<li>Reliable delivery against agreed service levels, quality and security requirements across the hub network.<\/li>\n<li>Capacity and forecast accuracy by pool, with healthy utilisation, controlled overtime and a clear response to peaks and gaps.<\/li>\n<li>Commercial performance supported by trusted operational data, early variance management and validated efficiency gains.<\/li>\n<li>Consistent controls and operating standards, evidenced through reviews, audit actions and business continuity readiness.<\/li>\n<li>Effective Hub Operations Leads, clear stakeholder confidence and decisions made at the right level.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p><strong>Requirements<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>Senior operations leadership in a complex, multi location production, agency, shared services or comparable environment, including management through local leaders and matrix teams.<\/li>\n<li>Strong command of capacity planning, workforce mix, service performance, financial controls and commercially consequential operational decisions.<\/li>\n<li>Ability to turn incomplete demand and cost data into practical scenarios, recommendations and executive decisions. Confident with metrics and able to challenge assumptions.<\/li>\n<li>Experience of scaling or reshaping hub operations, leading change in systems and processes, and managing security and continuity requirements.<\/li>\n<li>Direct, collaborative leadership; sound judgement under pressure; strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions; concise written and verbal communication.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p>#LI-LS1<\/p><div class=\"content-conclusion\"><p style=\"text-align: left;\"><strong>Why work here:&nbsp;<br><\/strong><span data-teams=\"true\">At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. We are the go-to fire safety partner for residential and commercial property professionals, delivering fast, reliable solutions that ensure full compliance and complete peace of mind.<\/p>\n<p>As part of the Helix International Group, Firetecnics combines specialist fire-safety expertise with the capability and backing of a wider risk, compliance and technology group.<\/p>\n<p>We provide fire detection, installation, service, maintenance and wider compliance solutions, combining technical expertise with responsive, personalised customer service.<\/p>\n<p><strong>Role Overview:<\/strong><\/p>\n<p>Firetecnics is strengthening its regional Service &amp; Maintenance capability and is looking for Fire Alarm Service &amp; Maintenance Engineers based in and around Brighton &amp; Hove. Customer &amp; deal volume is climbing fast.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we'll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Odin's operations run on around 50 processes, some code and some people, and plenty still held together by spreadsheets. Your job is to take each one apart, question why it exists, then rebuild it or kill it.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The simplest way to think about it: the numerator is how many deals we close, the denominator is what each deal costs us to run. You'll focus on the denominator, and the right person won't be able to stop themselves thinking about the numerator too.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>What you'll own<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Triage:<\/strong> Every operational problem comes to you before it reaches product and engineering. For each one you decide: scope it so precisely that engineering knows exactly what to build, or build it yourself.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cost per deal:<\/strong> There will be big early wins where a whole process can be ripped out and replaced. After that, doubling ops efficiency comes from 150 small changes, and you'll be the one making them.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Automation:<\/strong> You'll sit with the deal operations team, learn each workflow end to end, then build what replaces it. Most of what you ship you'll build without engineering. What does go to them arrives simple, scoped and usually with a working prototype attached.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Deleting things and saying no:<\/strong> You decide what belongs in our processes and what doesn't. If a way of working exists for no good reason, you kill it.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>The ops team:<\/strong> You'll lead the core deal operations team, deciding where their time goes while you rebuild the work around them.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>What we're looking for<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>You build, not buy:<\/strong> Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built real solutions with AI with no budget and no engineers. We want to see what you've shipped in Claude Code or similar.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Founder or product DNA:<\/strong> You've founded something, been early on a founding team, or worked as a product manager. That usually means four or more years of experience and a track record of finishing what you start.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Systems thinker:<\/strong> You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? You think about the whole business, not just your corner of it.<br \/>A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry \"given\", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>In the details and extremely on top of things:<\/strong> You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Numerate:<\/strong> Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You'll be automating a lot of numerical work - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Big plus: regulated financial services background:<\/strong> Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function.
